title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: three names ≠ actual cut from Adam's corruption
pass_a_gloss: Next I deny that by any of the three names Paul marked Adam's actual cut clean from the corruption it bred in him—yet our fight is about actual so cut. You want that lone actual to have earned the corruption for him and for us. You cannot prove, then, that ἁμαρτία here must mean that bare actual.
pass_b_english: Next I deny that the Apostle by any of those three names designated Adam's actual sin cut off from the corruption which it produced in Adam, although yet this our controversy must be understood of actual sin so cut off. For you will have it that by that actual sin of his Adam earned that corruption both for himself and for us. You cannot therefore prove that by hamartia in this place Adam's actual sin must be understood.
source_text: Deinde nego Apostolum ullo eorum trium nominum peccatum actuale Adami designasse praecisum à corruptione quam in Adamo peperit, cum tamen de peccato actuali ita praeciso intelligenda sit haec nostra controversia. Vis enim peccato illo suo actuali Adamum meruisse cum sibi tum nobis illam corruptionem. Non ergo potes probare per ἁμαρτίαν hoc loco peccatum actuale Adami esse intelligendum.

choices.choice: Fight is about actual cut from corruption; names don't give that
